title: Calib Audit Synthesis Harness for Dynamic Quant Acceptance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build an automated harness that synthesizes golden + adversarial cohorts and exercises FP8/INT8 calibration profiles to produce deterministic pass/fail signals for release gating. The harness ("Calib Audit Synth") should: 1) generate stratified test cohorts from production traces and synthetic perturbations, 2) run model variants (FP32 baseline, FP8 candidate, INT8 candidate) in paired shadow mode, 3) compute a multi-dimensional fidelity vector per-query (token-level KL, logit delta, top-k concordance, semantic similarity on embedding space), 4) apply hierarchical pass/fail gates (global, cohort, per-layer sensitivity) with configurable statistical process control thresholds, and 5) emit signed artifacts for rollouts (metrics snapshot, exemplar regressions, gating decision and justification).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness can run a 10k-query stratified cohort in < 4 hours on CI infra and produce a deterministic pass/fail result; 2) Metrics produced include token KLD, top-1/top-5 concordance, embedding cosine drift, and downstream task accuracy for at least two evals; 3) Configurable gates: global delta <= 0.5% accuracy drop OR KLD <= 0.02 and no cohort with high-sensitivity layer failures; 4) Output artifacts upload to S3 and Console rollout UI with links to failing exemplars; 5) Integration tests with the release pipeline (runtime-1.20) that block deploy when gate = fail.
design_notes: We avoid a single scalar threshold. Instead use a layered gate: global metric aggregation -> cohort-level z-score checks -> per-layer sensitivity detectors. Per-layer sensitivity uses layerwise attribution tests (freeze layer outputs, perturb weights with small noise) to flag fragile layers. Thresholds are initially conservative and will be relaxed after two successful canaries. We will synthesize adversarial perturbations by: token-level masking, prompt truncation, temperature / repetition injection, and paraphrase transforms via a backtranslation microservice. Synthetic cohorts are blended with sampled production traces (10% synthetic, 90% real) to expose rare failure modes.
runbook: - Kick off harness via CI job: ci/quant/calib-audit-synth. - Artifacts: s3://redwood-quant-audit/${key}/YYYYMMDD/{metrics.json, failing_examples.ndjson, model_traces.tgz}. - Rollout integration: Console rollout page reads s3 manifest and shows gating decision. - On fail: automatically create ENG child ticket with attached failing exemplars and suggested rollback policy.
progress_and_decisions: 2026-03-01: Initial proposal and scoping. 2026-03-04: Chose layered gate approach after trade-off session (cost vs false positives). 2026-03-07: Decided to use paired shadow runs to avoid non-deterministic rollouts. 2026-03-10: Prototype run completed on small cohort (1k queries) — observed systematic bias on long-context prompts; plan created to add temporal weighting to metrics. 2026-03-12: Performance optimization: moved KV-cache reuse into harness driver to reduce token replay cost by 30%.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Synthetic cohorts could overfit the guardrails and amplify false positives. Mitigation: maintain minimum 70% production-sampled queries per run and implement rotating synthetic perturbation seeds; manually review failing exemplars for first three canaries. Risk: compute cost of paired runs is high. Mitigation: implement progressive sampling (quick smoke on a 1k subset, full run only if smoke passes) and early-abort on catastrophic deviations.
metrics_and_gates: Primary metrics: token_KL, top1_concordance, top5_concordance, embedding_cosine_drift, downstream_task_accuracy. Gate logic: PASS if (downstream_accuracy_drop <= 0.5% AND token_KL <= 0.02) AND no cohort z-score > 3 on top1_concordance. Cohort exceptions: if a cohort is high-sensitivity (per-layer test triggers), require additional manual review. Metrics are logged as timeseries and baseline-adjusted using the preceding 7-day rolling window to account for natural drift.
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for metric calculators and gating logic. 2) End-to-end CI job that runs shadow FP32 vs FP8 for a 1k smoke cohort. 3) Canary in staging: 10k queries blended cohort. 4) Production canary: run behind feature flag for a single customer segment for two weeks before auto-unflagging.
notes_on_automation: Harness exposes a declarative YAML config for cohorts, metric weights, and gate thresholds so PMs and SREs can tune without code changes. A separate 'synth' module generates adversarial transforms and supports plugin transforms from NLP research experiments. We will gate config changes behind 'calib-audit-config' review and automate schema validation on deploy.
